design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable in the ML stage is a DIF label for items, not a PV-based cognitive achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The matching, text-readable full PDF does not report use or explicit non-use of sampling weights; full-text search found no weight terminology. Original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use student weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation using 10-fold cross-validation, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): Countries in data: USA. The MH method was applied to detect gender DIF among the nine items in the PIAAC 2012 numeracy assessment... We ultimately detected three out of nine items (33%).
design_fields._q2_audit: Full-text PDF check completed; no weight terminology, so not_met lacked the rubric-required explicit unweighted statement.
